# Nixotic

NixOS Flakes + Home Manager configuration.

## First-Time Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/axler8r/nixotic.git ~/.nixotic
cd ~/.nixotic
sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .
```

After the first build, use `nh os switch` for subsequent updates.
